title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Practice in the cold
hook: It is cold and windy. How do you keep kids warm and focused?
intro: Kids show up in big coats.
Half of them want to stand still.
statement: In cold weather, standing is the enemy.
q1: Do you cut the talking and keep kids moving —
q2: or shorten practice and send them home warm?
q3: How much of practice is spent standing?
t1: Every team is different. But cold practices work
t2: when no one stands for long.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle the cold?
ctaLines: Shorter talks. Tag games. Shorter practice.
Keep moving or cut it short?
ctaPrompt: Share your cold weather habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
It is cold and windy. How do you keep kids warm and focused?
Kids show up in big coats. Half of them want to stand still.
In cold weather, standing is the enemy.
Keep them moving or cut it short. There is no single right way.
How do you handle the cold? Share your habit in the comments.
